author: Times Radio
description:
“He could have said… If Macklemore is removed from the gig, then I will say free Palestine.”

Although musician and activist Billy Bragg feels sympathy for Ed Sheeran after Robert Kraft put him in an “invidious position”, he still should have been able to stand his ground and reinforce his support of Macklemore. 

Billy Bragg was speaking to Ayesha Hazarika on Times Radio Drive. Listen live every Saturday and Sunday from 4-7pm.

author: Times Radio
description:
Ironman ultra-triathlons demand competitors swim 2.4 miles, cycle 112 miles, and then run a full marathon, paying upwards of $1000 for the pleasure. It’s not everyone’s idea of a perfect Sunday, but for its growing base of devotees, it has become almost like a religion. So how did the sport grow from its low-key Hawaiian roots to a money-making global phenomenon? And what drives people to push their bodies to the limit?
